de.initial_population: the five development points and 29 Latin-hypercube points (scipy.stats.qmc.LatinHypercube with the seed of the run); the sequence is continued until 29 feasible points are drawn

stop_events.i: validation cost V at or below the near-noise threshold
stop_events.ii: two consecutive checks without a decrease of V of more than 0.5 % below its reference value

de.endpoint: checked candidate with the lowest V

lm.start: DE endpoint of the same run
lm.jacobian: central differences in z; a one-sided difference where one of the two points is infeasible

stop_events.validation: 10 iterations without a decrease of V of more than 0.5 % below its reference value
stop_events.validation_rise: V rises more than 0.5 % above its lowest value
stop_events.cost: an iteration lowers the training cost by less than a relative 1e-4
stop_events.step: an iteration moves z by less than 1e-3
stop_events.no_descent_step: no trial lowers the training cost

lm.endpoint: checked iterate with the lowest V, including the DE endpoint (iteration 0)

selected_endpoint: endpoint with the lowest V over the four runs of a setting; an exact tie goes to the earlier iteration and then to the lower seed number
